build_token_tensorizer_from_config: build a ScriptBasedTokenTensorizer from a Config object with tokenizer, vocab, and BOS/EOS settings
initialize_vocab_from_corpus: initialize the ScriptBasedTokenTensorizer vocabulary by streaming training corpus rows through the generator
numberize_text_row: numberize a text row by tokenizing and looking up token indices in the vocabulary
tensorize_batch: tensorize a batch of numberized rows into padded PyTorch tensors for GPU inference
review_token_tensorizer_script_impl: review the TokenTensorizerScriptImpl TorchScript module for tokenize, numberize, and tensorize forward methods
